hazards.reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature eats a full meal at the desk—this can be any food, not just the “food” at hand.

hazards.name: Unbearable Sorrow
hazards.notes: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.
hazards.disable: DC 32 Deception or Performance (master) to laugh away the sadness, DC 31 Occultism (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, DC 33 Thievery (master) to disperse the emotional energy
hazards.reset: The trap resets automatically after 24 hours.

hazards.name: Unfinished Portalrender
hazards.notes: A sphere of concentrated agony harvested from a qlippoth begins pulsing with violet light as it blasts the room with otherworldly agony.
hazards.disable: DC 37 Thievery (master) to dismantle the housing and refocus the agony inward so it consumes itself harmlessly, DC 33 Arcana or Occultism (master) to vent the agony in a controlled way that causes the portalrender to become inert after 1 minute (during which it can still be triggered normally), or dispel magic (7th level; counteract DC 31)

hazards.name: Unholy Hunger
hazards.notes: An unspeakable miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.
hazards.disable: DC 19 Cooking Lore to neutralize the haunted soup with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or DC 25 Religion to exorcise the haunt.
hazards.reset: The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.

hazards.name: Unsafe Stairs
hazards.notes: The rickety stairs groan and strain alarmingly if a Small or larger creature ascends them.
hazards.disable: DC 16 Crafting to quickly jury-rig some supports to prevent the stairs from collapsing

hazards.name: Unspeakable Impressions
hazards.notes: A trail of over-sized footprints crosses the path, markings of the apparently recent passage of a dangerous and mind-shattering entity whose stride …
hazards.disable: DC 46 Deception (master) to distract those (including yourself) compelled to follow footprints, or DC 43 Survival (legendary) to quickly obscure the trail
hazards.reset: The unspeakable impressions fade once they are triggered, but reform somewhere else in the vicinity 24 hours later unless they are successfully disabled.

hazards.name: Unstable Fiendfire Cage
hazards.notes: The Fiendflame Cage is uncontrolled, releasing holy light and hellfire in the area.
hazards.disable: DC 48 Arcana , Nature , Occultism , or Religion (master) four times on the Fiendflame Cage to calm it through ritual incantations
hazards.reset: The trap resets after 24 hours.

hazards.name: Unstable Pit
hazards.notes: This open pit was once covered with branches— it's now visible, but its unstable edges are not obvious.

hazards.name: Unwelcome Guests
hazards.notes: Unwelcome guests who touch this hatch are cursed.
hazards.disable: DC 28 Occultism (expert) to drain the magic from the curse, DC 31 Thievery (master) to unweave the curse's bindings, or dispel magic (4th rank, counteract DC 28) to counteract the curse
hazards.reset: The trap resets when the hatch is shut.

hazards.name: Unwelcoming Facade
hazards.notes: An unsettling wave of malice and sinister energy ripples invisibly out from the manor, causing those who view the building to see a leering, evil …
hazards.disable: DC 32 Occultism or Religion to exorcise the haunt, DC 35 Society to approach the manor in a proper way that defers to its occupant’s symbolic standing in the community; displaying an official pass that legally grants permission to enter the building reduces both of these DCs by 5 (provided the PCs approach the front door and not from another direction).
hazards.reset: The haunt resets immediately if not disabled and can be triggered again the next round.

hazards.name: Urgathoa's Ire
hazards.notes: A statue of Urgathoa fires eye beams at intruders.
hazards.disable: DC 48 Religion (legendary) to disenchant each eye through prayer or DC 48 Thievery (legendary) to disable each eye

hazards.name: Valmar's Pit Trap
hazards.notes: The ground here is made of loosely packed soil that, when stepped upon, collapses.
hazards.disable: DC 22 Survival (trained) to reinforce the dirt so it’s safe to walk on, or DC 18 Thievery (trained) to collapse the trap from a safe distance
hazards.reset: Creatures can still fall into the pit, but the soil must be replaced for the trap to become <%CONDITIONS%79%%>hidden<%END> again.

hazards.name: Vault-Drowned Souls
hazards.notes: The spirits of the island’s citizens manifest and panic as the vault fills with seawater.
hazards.stealth: +22 (expert) to sense the terror of the spirits inside the vault
hazards.disable: DC 33 Athletics (trained) twice to Force Open the vault’s door or DC 30 Religion (trained) three times to exorcise the spirits
hazards.reset: The waters recede and the spirits disappear once no living creatures remain inside the vault, but the haunt resets immediately, triggering again if a living creature steps inside.

hazards.name: Vengeful Furnace
hazards.notes: The hatch atop the haunted furnace flips open and disgorges a pair of shrieking, burning ghosts.
hazards.disable: DC 22 Intimidation (trained) to cow one of the vengeful spirits or DC 25 Religion (trained) to exorcise the spirit. The haunt remains active until both spirits are cowed or exorcised, or until the furnace is destroyed.
hazards.reset: The haunt resets 1 hour after there are no creatures in the room.

hazards.name: Venom Pool
hazards.notes: A shallow, foul-smelling puddle of toxic acid blocks a narrow hall, and poison bursts from it when disturbed.
hazards.stealth: +30 (legendary) to distinguish between the hazard and the oozes within it; DC 0 to notice the pool
hazards.disable: DC 40 Crafting (master) or DC 42 Survival (legendary) to neutralize the acid while within reach of it. Three successes using either skill (or a combination of both) destroys the hazard.
hazards.reset: The hazard ends after 1 minute, contracting to its original size and keeping still until disturbed again.

hazards.name: Violent Shove
hazards.notes: An invisible force bats creatures aside, hurling them into a nearby wall.
hazards.stealth: DC 23 (trained) to feel an ominous presence in the room
hazards.disable: DC 19 Occultism (trained) to disperse the force or DC 20 Religion (trained) to ward yourself from harm
hazards.reset: 1 day

hazards.name: Violet Mister
hazards.notes: Opening the door pulls a thread, which causes a plant mister to spray a cloud of poison into the triggering creature’s face.
hazards.stealth: DC 20 (trained) to notice the trap’s trigger-thread attached to the door
hazards.disable: DC 18 Thievery to safely cut the thread

hazards.name: Vision of Dahak
hazards.notes: Blasts of fire and smoke pour out of the tunnel walls to coalesce into the burning form of Dahak himself; a PC who succeeds at a DC 20 Religion …
hazards.disable: Religion DC 26 (expert) to utter prayers to a nonevil deity to counteract Dahak's presence (prayers to Apsu allow this check to be made if the character is merely trained in Religion), Thievery DC 30 (expert) to divert the hazard's energies back upon themselves, or a successful dispel magic (4th level; counteract DC 26).
hazards.reset: The vision of Dahak deactivates and resets automatically once no creatures remain within the Huntergate way station.

hazards.name: Void Garden
hazards.notes: Six eerie purple crystals react to the presence of life, pulsing with flashes of violet light that seem to match the heartbeats of living creatures …
hazards.disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) or DC 35 Nature (master) to discern a hairline fracture that, when struck, shatters a crystal to dust
hazards.reset: The void garden deactivates 1 round after all living targets leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

hazards.name: Volatile Reagents
hazards.notes: Potion bottles, alembics, and potent ingredients violently explode when jostled and accidentally combined.
hazards.disable: three DC 20 Acrobatics or Crafting checks to sort and separate the bottles of volatile ingredients into groups
hazards.reset: The lab contains enough ingredients for this hazard to last 1 minute before all materials are expended. Alternatively, the hazard resets once Slick shrinks to regular size (see below).

hazards.name: Vorpal Executioner
hazards.notes: A wickedly sharp saw blade descends and travels along grooves in a complex path throughout the room, attempting to decapitate everyone within.
hazards.disable: DC 41 Thievery (expert) at four different junctions to jam all the saw blade’s possible paths, preventing it from traveling through the room
hazards.reset: The trap resets over the course of the round and can be triggered again 1 round later.

hazards.name: Wailing Crystals
hazards.notes: Three clusters of gleaming, colorful crystals are corrupted with necromantic energy that causes them to reflect negative emotions. All three must be …
hazards.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
hazards.stealth: +27 (master) or DC 37 (master) to notice what appear to be screaming ghostly faces in the crystals
hazards.disable: Thievery DC 29 (master) to carefully fracture the crystals or Crafting DC 27 (expert) to place objects to stop the resonance, both disabling one 5-foot patch of crystals.
hazards.reset: The wailing crystals deactivate and reset once no living creatures are within 20 feet.

hazards.name: Warding Bell
hazards.notes: At the heart of the shrine hangs a massive bronze temple bell.
hazards.disable: Ringing the bell as an Interact action eight times in succession with the ceremonial ringer (carried by Mago Kai) over the course of three consecutive rounds automatically deactivates the hazard, DC 36 Religion to appeal to Pharasma to extinguish the flame, DC 36 Thievery to extinguish the flame within the bell, or dispel magic (6th rank; counteract DC 29) or a shimmerthief’s Drain Light ability to disable the wards
hazards.reset: Reactivating the warding bell requires a complicated rite taking several days.

hazards.name: Watcher In The Wastes
hazards.notes: A massive sculpture of a wolflike form as tall as a mountain guards passage to the Cold Wastes at the northern end of Leng and seems almost ready to …
hazards.stealth: DC 48 (master) to realize the mountain is dangerous (DC 0 to see the towering statue in the first place)
hazards.disable: DC 51 Stealth (master) to avoid the initial notice of the gigantic form, or DC 48 Occultism (legendary) to know the proper posture and hand sign to make to turn away the watcher’s attention
hazards.reset: The nightmare resets immediately.

hazards.name: Watching wall
hazards.notes: An overwhelming feeling of being watched wells up in the minds of those in the room, an instant before an eerie red eye opens in the western wall.
hazards.disable: DC 22 Deception (trained) to appear uninteresting to the watching eye (and thus be ignored by it) or DC 22 Religion (trained) to ward against being seen by or affected by the eye
hazards.reset: The haunt becomes inert at the end of any round in which there are no frightened creatures it can see. It stays dormant for 1 hour, after which point it resets.

hazards.name: Weakened Floor
hazards.notes: The weakened floor gives way with a tremendous crash, dropping everything in the room into a muddy morass of toxic mold.
hazards.disable: DC 33 Crafting (master) three times to knock holes in the floor without triggering the spore cloud while simultaneously lightening the strain on the floor so it can be walked upon, DC 36 Stealth (expert) to move carefully through the room for the remainder of your turn without triggering the hazard, or DC 36 Nature (expert) twice once the trap is triggered to knock enough holes into the nearby walls to cause the spores to disperse
hazards.reset: One minute after nothing moves in the room, the spores settle down. The floor remains obvious and won’t collapse further, but any creature that moves through the mold causes the spores to plume up again, re-triggering the trap.

hazards.name: Web Lurker Deadfall
hazards.notes: A web tripwire lets loose a bundle of boulders that fall on all targets within a 10-foot square.
hazards.disable: Survival (trained) or Thievery (expert) DC 20 to rearrange the webbing

hazards.name: Web Lurker Noose
hazards.notes: Discreet webbing at throat level snags a creature that walks into it.
hazards.disable: Survival (trained) or Thievery (expert) DC 18 to rearrange the webbing

hazards.name: Weight of Guilt
hazards.notes: Influenced by the guilt and regrets of the dead, creatures are wrapped in weighted chains that embody their own sins.
hazards.stealth: DC 30 (expert) to sense an oppressive aura of sorrow
hazards.disable: DC 26 Religion (expert) to disrupt the haunt through prayer or DC 27 Deception (expert) to openly defy your regrets and banish the haunt. Creatures who haven't committed sins or already made amends for their transgressions are immune to the effects of this haunt.
hazards.reset: 1 day

hazards.name: Wheel of Misery
hazards.notes: An ornate wheel set into a wall—divided into six segments with colored runes on each—is controlled by a magical sensor that detects any creature …
hazards.stealth: +16 (expert) to detect the magical sensor; noticing the wheel has a DC of 0
hazards.disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) on the wheel to stop it from spinning, DC 22 Thievery (master) to erase each rune, or dispel magic (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract each rune
hazards.reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving within range of its sensor.

hazards.name: Whispers From Long Ago
hazards.notes: As the door is opened, unsettling whispering radiates outward, worming its way into the mind of the one who dared intrude.
hazards.disable: DC 27 Thievery (master) to deface the subtly hidden triggering runes around the door's circumference, or dispel magic (4th level; counteract DC 23) to counteract the trap
hazards.reset: The trap resets over the course of a round and is ready to whisper at the next person who attempts to open the door 1 round later.

hazards.name: Wind Surge
hazards.notes: Hurricane-force winds rip through the area as Agyra flies past.
hazards.stealth: DC 27 (expert) to note stirrings in the wind
hazards.disable: DC 27 Athletics (expert) or Acrobatics (expert) to crouch and contort out of the wind's way (disables the hazard for only yourself), DC 30 Survival to point out a safe space from the winds for up to 3 creatures

hazards.name: Witch-Priests' Curse
hazards.notes: Anyone who opens a secret compartment is subjected to a powerful curse.
hazards.source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands
hazards.disable: DC 39 Thievery (legendary) to carefully remove the bone fetish that holds the curse.
hazards.reset: The trap resets if both secret compartments are shut.

hazards.name: Witherweird Runes
hazards.notes: Magic stored in runes painted in powdered bone and banshees’ tears lash out at anyone other than Heh Shan-Bao who opens the secondary compartment.
hazards.disable: DC 37 Disable Device to scratch out the runes and dissipate their magic harmlessly, DC 40 Arcana to sabotage the spell and cause the runes to dry up and blow away as inert powder, or dispel magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the runes

hazards.name: Wooden Bullets Trap
hazards.notes: A hopper full of wooden sling bullets is attached to several launching devices, which spew the bullets at high velocity through various holes in the …
hazards.disable: DC 17 Thievery (trained) to reinforce the porch pressure sensor or DC 15 Crafting (trained) to cover the holes launching the bullets
hazards.reset: The trap stops after 10 rounds or when the weight on the porch is removed, whichever comes first. The trap can operate for a total of 10 rounds before its ammunition is exhausted.

hazards.name: Wrath of the Destroyer
hazards.notes: These heavy doors, carved with an image of Dahak , echo with a hatred so powerful that it can kill anyone who comes nearby, manifesting a vision of …
hazards.stealth: +22 (expert) to notice subtle vapors of magical energy seething across the doors
hazards.disable: Thievery DC 29 (expert) to disrupt the divine magic, Religion DC 29 (expert) to placate the wrathful energies, or dispel magic (5th level; counteract DC 26).
hazards.reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature being in range

hazards.name: Wrathful Dinosaur
hazards.notes: This figurine of a charging triceratops was crafted from the dinosaur's femur and contains its spirit.
hazards.disable: DC 24 Nature (expert) to banish the dinosaur's spirit with a primal incantation, DC 28 Intimidation to scare it off with a frightening display, or DC 26 Survival (expert) to calm the spirit
hazards.reset: 1 day

hazards.name: Writhing Hair
hazards.notes: A ghostly woman floats quietly through the shop, plucking hair and sending it slithering into the rafters or out to infest uncooked steamed buns.
hazards.disable: DC 23 Diplomacy to calm the upset spirit down, or DC 21 Religion to convince the spirit to abandon the haunting via prayer. If the PCs use Hinode Akari’s name or otherwise let the haunt know that they understand her story, checks to Disable this haunt gain a +2 circumstance bonus.

hazards.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
hazards.notes: A monk's tormented spirit attacks intruders.
hazards.disable: DC 32 Irori Lore (trained) to clean the room and return the prayer items to their proper arrangement, DC 37 Religion (expert) to state an Iroran prayer of peace and put the haunt to rest, or DC 40 Occultism (master) to create a ward against future hauntings
hazards.reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature lights all of the candles in the room and offers a prayer to Irori.

hazards.name: Yellow Mold
hazards.notes: Poisonous mold spores assault nearby creatures.
hazards.disable: Survival DC 26 (expert) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

hazards.name: Zogototaru
hazards.notes: Narseigus's worm-calling enchantments have attained imperfect control over Zogototaru, compelling her to aid him. She follows his directions loosely …
hazards.disable: DC 28 Arcana or DC 28 Occultism (trained) to identify a loophole in mind-controlling magic, DC 30 Diplomacy to reason with Zogototaru, or DC 31 Deception or Performance to speak as if the PC were Taargick

hazards.name: Zutha's Legacy
hazards.notes: The scowling visage of Runelord Zutha appears above the altar. Meanwhile, mask-like versions of Zutha’s face manifest on nearby rubble and vomit …
hazards.stealth: +48 (expert) to sense Zutha’s hungry spirit before it manifests
hazards.disable: DC 45 Occultism (legendary) or Religion (legendary) to exorcise Zutha’s spirit, or DC 48 Intimidation (master) or Performance (master) to recite the details of Zutha’s defeat; six total successes are required to disable the haunt.
hazards.reset: The haunt deactivates once no living creatures remain nearby. The haunt resets 1 hour later.
